'''Anooba Press''' was a publishing company that operated during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The company was a subsidiary of [[Tuvunna, Inc]] and it was based within [[Suite 44800]] of the property [[830-303 Satele Shan Boulevard]], in the [[Azda Cluster]] region of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. At some point, the company published ''[[Making a Killing]]'', a memoir of the famed [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] and leader of the [[Bounty Hunters' Guild/Legends|Bounty Hunters' Guild]], [[Cradossk/Legends|Cradossk]]. The company's logo consisted of a silhouette of an [[Anooba/Legends|Anooba]], a dangerous predator from the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TBHC" />
